title: The brown gym
content: Does anyone ever see a gym? It’s two stories with the middle being open air and the cardio machines on a sort of balcony second level. Everything feels old, maybe from the 80’s and the walls and carpet are all shades of brown. Downstairs there is a long, dimly lit hallway with brown carpet that leads to an indoor pool. The whole area is very dimly lit and seems slightly dirty. There are only ever two or three other people in the area, even though it is huge! Not sure if it’s related, but has the same feel as the mall and beach world I dream about.
